answer_1.quote: Further, the high-quality dialogue-character association is pertinent for generating engaging text-to-speech for novels with distinct voice profiles for characters.
datasets: 15 books sampled from the most popular titles from time epochs 1881 -2018

answer_2.quote: We compute precision, recall and F1-Score, all weighted averages, of the character entities attributed to each span of direct speech.

answer_4.quote: The annotation is carried out by 3 expert English native annotators, each reading the book in sequential order, over a BRAT based annotation interface. In case the annotation from any single annotator is different, a master annotator goes through the cases and makes the correction, resulting in a dataset with a very high agreement (Cohen's Kappa greater than 0.9).
answer_4.guideline: annotator selects the span of text representing a character's direct speech... attributes a character entity to the utterance... mentions are then clustered per book into character entities
